decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement and Flood Risk Assessment [received on 29 November 2018], 2240/P1/A and 2240/L1/A [received on 29 January 2019] and 2240/P2/B [received on 13 February 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of single storey rear extension and construction of new single storey rear extension to ground floor flat and internal alterations to convert from one-bedroom to two-bedroom flat.
